settings.section_heading: People on GLP-1. Real words. Not ours.

settings.heading: Will these upset my stomach? GLP-1 meds already make eating rough.
settings.row_content: We hear this one a lot, and the short answer is: these are one of the few things people on GLP-1s say they CAN eat without issues. They're small (one stick, done), they're not greasy, and there's no whey protein or sugar alcohols — the usual suspects for GI trouble on these meds. That said, everyone's tolerance is different. Start with one and see how you feel. Most people are pleasantly surprised.

settings.heading: I can barely eat 500–800 calories a day. Why would I buy snacks?
settings.row_content: Because every one of those calories needs to pull its weight. If you've only got 600 calories to work with, 100 of them delivering 7g of clean protein is one of the smartest moves you can make. Think of it less as 'snacking' and more as 'strategic protein delivery in a format your stomach won't reject.'

settings.heading: Is this just processed meat with a health sticker on it?
settings.row_content: We're a butcher shop, not a factory. FireCreek sticks are made from real beef and pork with ingredients you can read and pronounce. No nitrates, no MSG, no 'natural flavors' as a catch-all, no protein isolate injected to pump up the numbers. A registered dietitian helped develop the nutritional profile. A butcher made sure it tastes like food, not a supplement.

settings.heading: My doctor/dietitian told me to focus on whole foods.
settings.row_content: Good. Listen to them. We're not trying to replace whole foods. But here's what we've heard from hundreds of GLP-1 users: the gap between 'I know I need protein' and 'I can physically eat enough protein' is real. A FireCreek stick fills that gap on the days when a full chicken breast isn't happening. It's not instead of whole foods — it's alongside them, for the moments when whole foods aren't realistic.

settings.heading: How is this different from regular jerky?
settings.row_content: Jerky is dried out, tough, and usually loaded with sugar and sodium to compensate. FireCreek sticks are a different product entirely — moist, tender, and seasoned like something you'd actually want to eat, not something you chew for 10 minutes and give up on. The protein density per calorie is also higher than most jerky brands because we're not padding the recipe with sugar and soy sauce.

settings.heading: What's the best way to work these into my day on GLP-1?
settings.row_content: Most of our GLP-1 customers keep 2–3 sticks staged throughout their day. One mid-morning, one mid-afternoon, maybe one after a workout or before bed if they're short on protein. The goal isn't to eat more food — it's to make the small amount of food you can eat do more for you. Some pair it with a string cheese or a few crackers. Some eat it solo. There's no wrong way to do this.
